opener: Wealth management led the day's deals, with Harborview, Meridian and Crestline buying RIAs and two minority stakes. Outside wealth, the largest stated prices were Halcyon Energy's $5.6 billion deal for Redstone Midstream and Vireo Pharma's $3.2 billion purchase of Calder Therapeutics. Atlas Industrial and Granite Peak Partners each closed deals.

items.summary: Harborview Wealth Partners agreed to buy Summit Ridge Advisors, an RIA with $1.2 billion in assets, with closing expected in the fourth quarter.
items.why_it_matters: Another sizable RIA sale shows consolidators are still paying up for established firms, a reference point for advisors weighing a sale.

items.summary: Northwind Software agreed to acquire Brightpath Analytics for $420 million.
items.why_it_matters: Software buyers keep adding analytics tools to their platforms, which keeps demand high for smaller data companies.

items.summary: Private equity firm Granite Peak Partners completed its purchase of Lumen Dental Group, a 40-office dental group in Colorado and Utah.
items.why_it_matters: Dental groups remain a steady target for private equity roll-ups of regional health care practices.

items.summary: Atlas Industrial completed its $2.1 billion acquisition of Meridian Steel.
items.why_it_matters: Closing the deal gives Atlas Industrial more of its own steel supply as industrial buyers consolidate suppliers.

items.summary: Broker-dealer Stonebridge Securities acquired Calloway Partners, a boutique investment bank that advises on M&A.
items.why_it_matters: Buying an advisory boutique is a quick way for a broker-dealer to add an M&A practice and its client relationships.

items.summary: PE-backed Crestline Wealth closed its purchase of Riverbend Financial and also plans to buy Aspen Grove Advisors.
items.why_it_matters: Private-equity-funded RIA buyers doing several deals at once keep competition for independent practices high.

items.summary: Halcyon Energy agreed to buy Redstone Midstream for $5.6 billion, after earlier reports of talks between the two.
items.why_it_matters: A deal of this size would add pipeline assets to Halcyon and shows midstream consolidation continuing.

items.summary: Copperline Bancorp and First Prairie Bank agreed to merge in a $1.1 billion deal, creating a bank with $14 billion in assets.
items.why_it_matters: Regional bank mergers of this size build scale to spread technology and compliance costs.

items.summary: Blue Heron Capital took a minority stake in Oakmont Family Office, which oversees $2.3 billion for 60 families.
items.why_it_matters: Outside capital is reaching family offices too, not only traditional RIAs.

items.summary: Meridian Capital Partners agreed to buy Cedar Lane Private Wealth, an $850 million RIA in Charlotte, its first Southeast office.
items.why_it_matters: Buyers expanding into new regions through acquisitions raise the bar for local firms competing for clients.

items.summary: Northgate Advisors and Pinecrest Wealth agreed to merge into a $4.5 billion firm under the Northgate name, with both founders as co-CEOs.
items.why_it_matters: Mergers of equals are an option for firms that want scale without selling to a larger acquirer.

items.summary: Willowbrook Wealth took a minority investment from Bear Mountain Capital.
items.why_it_matters: Minority stakes give founders capital while they keep control, an alternative to an outright sale.

items.summary: Maple & Main agreed to acquire Thistle Home in a $640 million deal.
items.why_it_matters: Home goods brands are consolidating as larger retailers look for growth through acquisitions.

items.summary: Vireo Pharma agreed to buy Calder Therapeutics for $3.2 billion, adding a late-stage oncology drug.
items.why_it_matters: Large drugmakers keep buying late-stage cancer assets to refill their pipelines.
Payments companies keep buying startups to add features rather than build them.
